comparison.objective: Trim two fingernails straight across while stabilizing the fingers and avoiding skin.
comparison.physical_skill: Submillimetric clipper placement, force actuation, and bimanual human-part stabilization.
comparison.success_condition: Both nails retain 1–2 mm even white edges, no nick or pinch occurs, clipper is set down, and hands withdraw.
comparison.reason: Tests precision cutting near vulnerable anatomy, wholly different from sieve manipulation.
